workarounds.symptom: bug(viewer): cannot rerun failed job analysis
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(viewer): allow rerunning failed job analysis. Target files: apps/viewer/app/routes/job.tsx. When a job analysis run fails (for example, Docker is missing), the viewer saves a report that contains only the errors. From then on the Analysis tab shows those errors but no Run analysis button, so the only way to retry is to delete `analysis.json` by hand. Before Fix: After Fix:
